signal_text: A Gumroad help center article (dated May 12, 2022 per search index) states that if PayPal is not supported in a seller's country, Gumroad cannot pay them out, and explicitly lists Payoneer, wire deposits, and bitcoin as unavailable alternatives.
subject_exact: Gumroad inability to pay sellers in countries where PayPal is unsupported, with no alternative payout method
local_qualifiers: If PayPal is not supported in your country
extraction_notes: Source dated May 2022. Payoneer, wire deposits, bitcoin explicitly excluded as alternatives. Payout layer.
